system.description: Once per encounter as a Swift Action, you can channel your anger and hatred into your allies. All allies within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight gain a +1 rage bonus on attack rolls, but take a -2 penalty to their Reflex Defense. This effect lasts until the encounter ends, or until you are knocked unconscious or killed.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
